notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title and description, but not favicon or preview image.
REF-BM-03: Title and description can be edited only after the bookmark is saved.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-07: List items expose title, description, and tags, but no favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry has no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and hostname, but not notes or the complete URL.
REF-BM-14: The #tag query syntax is not parsed.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases receive no exact-match handling.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action facility.
REF-BM-21: Actions cannot target the whole currently filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: Ordering is hard-coded by creation date; no sort-key selection is implemented.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: Bookmark archiving is absent.
REF-BM-27: No reversible archive operation exists distinct from permanent deletion.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks view.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are absent.
